images.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: original villain character design and performance sheet for Starfall, a gentle celestial puzzle game.
Create a polished landscape 3:2 art-direction sheet titled exactly "MURK — THE HUNGRY MOON" and subtitled "Working character concept". This is an original whimsical antagonist, not a Nintendo character. Think tactile miniature fantasy: softly faceted matte moonstone, plush cloud vapor, luminous glassy stolen starlight, expressive storybook acting, refined premium game concept art.
Murk is a small lopsided charcoal-violet moon creature, roughly twice the size of the friendly gem-like star helpers. Clear moon-orb silhouette with an asymmetric pale crescent rim, two detached little crescent-shaped hands, large expressive pale eyes with strong brows, a comically greedy expandable mouth, and a short soft smoky comet tail that acts like a scarf in flight. Fine seams in the dark moonstone reveal colorful captured light inside. Personality: a vain theatrical light thief who thinks all beautiful light should belong to it; mischievous, not horrific. No wizard hat, broom, robe, wand, turtle features, skulls or sharp monster teeth.
Composition: ivory/lavender presentation paper, generous negative space. Upper half: one large three-quarter hero pose left, smaller clean front and side silhouette studies center, four facial expressions right (scheming, inhaling, smugly full, startled). Lower half: a clean four-panel visual acting strip with readable labels "ARRIVE", "FEAST", "GLOAT", "FLEE". Murk swoops toward a miniature celestial lantern, inhales its light as a ribbon of gold/rose/aqua, glows happily with stolen color, flees with a comic backward glance. The lantern becomes quiet and muted but remains visible. Use consistent identity in every pose. A few tiny friendly faceted five-point star helpers at the lower left establish scale, never harmed. No logos, no gameplay UI, no watermark. Restrained crisp readable typography. Mark small footer "CONCEPT — NOT GAMEPLAY".

images.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: high-level world-map concept art for an original gentle celestial puzzle game called STARFALL.
Make an exceptionally clear, charming, polished portrait 2:3 overview titled "STARFALL" with subtitle "A journey to bring the light back". A cohesive universe of exactly TWELVE small self-contained floating miniature realms, four visually related regions of three realms, all connected in one clear continuous winding route. Premium tactile diorama art: softly rounded clay and cut-paper forms, matte moonstone edges, luminous glass inserts, fabric clouds, cosmic deep-blue backdrop, generous negative space. Original fantasy, no Nintendo characters, castles, pipes, mushroom imagery or logos. No giant central gameplay board. The route consists of delicate dotted starlight and small bridges; it starts lower-left and ends upper-left. Exactly twelve readable small circular numbered location badges "01" through "12", one per destination. Do not put location names in the art. Make all twelve destinations distinct, spacious and countable; no extra numbered nodes. Most of the lower realms appear warmly restored; more distant realms are gently muted and still, with visible potential; this is an illustrative mixed-progress map.
Layout in FOUR HORIZONTAL TIERS, three compact realms each, clear serpentine route:
BOTTOM tier, lavender clouds/cream ceramic/rosewood, left to right: 01 a tiny landing dock with a big lantern mast; 02 a broken flowing ribbon bridge joining two miniature cloud banks (one destination); 03 a little harbor of paper-kite boats with folded sails. Route goes 01 to02 to03 then up to04 directly above right.
LOWER MIDDLE tier, leafy moonstone/mint water/opal ice, RIGHT TO LEFT: 04 a tiny round seed moon with a single curled seed unfolding; 05 a suspended bowl of gently flowing silver water with lily steps; 06 a quiet orchard of translucent bell-shaped frost fruit. Route 04 to05 to06 then up to07 above left.
UPPER MIDDLE tier, warm copper/slate/amber, LEFT TO RIGHT: 07 a small star-powered windmill with round copper vanes; 08 three enormous hanging chimes on a little crescent island; 09 a whimsical station with a single short star ferry and circular brass launch rail. Route07 to08 to09 then up to10 above right.
TOP tier, deep violet/silver/prismatic light, RIGHT TO LEFT: 10 a tiny frozen aurora waterfall over a dark glass arch; 11 a pale flower-shaped lighthouse with a closed central lens; 12 a cracked crown-like ring of moonstone around a hollow light reservoir, clearly the final destination on the UPPER LEFT. Route10 to11 to12, no edge back to01.
At far upper-left above12, a small comical charcoal moon villain with pale crescent rim, two little detached hands and a smoky comet tail carries colorful stolen light. Keep it small enough not to hide the last three nodes. A group of tiny aqua/amber/mint/rose/violet gem-like star helpers travels near01. Shared star emblems, rounded edges and light ribbons make all realms feel one universe. Clean readable spatial hierarchy, consistent shallow-oblique camera for every diorama, slight depth but no overlapping destinations. Footer "12 LOCATION CONCEPT • NOT GAMEPLAY".
